triggers: Below the tail of the Fish is a silently fading silvergate.
Along the path to the mighty city of Galengarde, an enshrined warped mushroom hides a deeper path.
A signpost near the Port points two ways. Ignore them both and seek the spores nearby that have grown over the Silvergate you seek.
Something about this Silvergate must have drawn the Dichen to build a tall bell tower around it.
Once a village for witches, now abandoned in the shadow of the Tree of Life. This fountain holds the secret.
Once a settlement for the Dichen, now filled with toxic spores, a gate has been grown over by a towering mushroom that can still be contacted.
Where watery passage exits near the Bastille, a small structure lies, overgrown by berries. It holds the way.
A mighty fallen tree provides passage deeper into spore-infested territory. Seek where the spiders call home.
Not far from the Mycelian territory stands a spear-wielding statue with a secret.
A place where horse and rider are one and the same, as the great Tree of Life looms above and holds a path yet unseen.
A place where horse and rider are one and the same, as the great Tree of Life looms above holds a path yet unseen.
A totem for the Porphyry was once a pathway walked by many. It can be again if you can find it.
Where bewitching magic swirls dangerously, seek the chapel that offers no harm. Here a path awaits the seeker.
Taking the wrong seat in the bar within a mushroom might take you somewhere much further than expected.
Near hanging flowers and bowing trees, one might gaze upon Galengarde's Southern aqueduct on this overgrown structure and seek a path.
Nearby, a mighty sword stands tall. But here, one might seek shelter below a tree contained by water and surrounded by fungi.
Within sight of a silent fishing vessel, the Porphyry's sacred grounds hold a passage elsewhere.
Crystallized magic swirls wild in the presence of the Hex and the Tree of Life together. That magic might whisk one away.
The Silver Order has claimed what the Witches have destroyed near the walls of New Antium. Seek the way beyond the water wheel.
The Silver Order has claimed what Witches have destroyed near the walls of New Antium. Seek the way beyond the water wheel.
A blooming flower atop a grown lilypad on the west shore marks the pathway to the beyond.
Nearby, a mighty sword stands tall. But here, a view upon the ocean stands close to a wooded and crystallized grotto with a gate yet unseen.
The mighty gates of Antium draw the eye, but this small pavilion offers a way forward.
The mighty gates of Antium draw the eye, but the small pavilion offers a way forward.
Antium's smoldering embers hide a passage where soldiers rest.
Betwixt Antium's mighty cathedral and worn racetrack, a gate has faded to just beyond view.
Once a mighty tree near a shade-infested quarry, it still retains its passage to somewhere beyond.
Where shades still prowl, a blacksmith has abandoned his forge and a path remains unseen.
Outside of the Keep, although not quite yet upon the Serebrian Bridge is a tree with a path that goes deeper than any roots.
Just upon the Serebrian Bridge stand two soldiers, watching the moon rise. Stand between them and the way shall open.
An unknowable domed structure near a twisted place where ocean touches emptiness below offers a path to somewhere else.
A silent watchtower stands alone next to the twisted, unknowable remnants of an isle that was once captured.
This silent tower stands above the chittering entryway to the Gutters from the mighty megastructure. Atop the tower, you will find a gently pulsing gateway, bathing in moonlight.

A temple built to house enchanted waters rests by a ledge, admiring the mighty clock tower. Let it not distract you, for it is the tiny altar that shall reveal the path.
Gaze from a ledge above onto the twisted structure that serves as the final reminder of a mighty battle near the great bridge. Nearby lies the flame of a faraway beacon.
In fields of amethyst, a banner hangs tattered, marking a site of great importance for your search.
Turn away from the Stars' gifts and instead seek a hidden gate below the edge.
An ancient aqueduct once carried water across the Serebrian isle. Now the crumbling edge reveals a fading Silvergate.
Two knights bear the cloth of the Serebrian Citadel, overlooking the mighty Silvergate. A smaller one lies between the two, barely glimmering.
A boon to a fractured Tree of Life hides passage to something deeper. Inside the passage, a platform will take new shape as you approach.
A blighted ledge overlooks a blighted tree where no other corruption spreads, in the shadow of the Emperor's gaze.
Gaze upon the Lord's Visage then seek the way forward behind his presence.
Deep under the starblight, pumpkins sprout in twisting tunnels. Seek a tiny altar that will open to more, but beware: if you find an unfamiliar corpse, you've gone too far.
In the sunless caves deep under the starblight, gourds grow unhindered in the stale air, their twisting vines unnaturally crumbling away rock and stone to make passage.
A coffin within hidden Serebrian crypts opens not to the wail of the dead, but a pathway to somewhere else.
